description: Scores how well a dApp or website domain is protected against hijacking: registrar transfer/update locks, registry lock, DNSSEC, CAA, expiry, nameserver consistency across resolvers, SRI on third-party scripts and the Content-Security-Policy header. Returns a 0-100 score, each check with pass/fail/unknown and advice. Results are cached for an hour.

domain.description: Domain name, e.g. app.example.com. A URL is accepted too; only the host is used.

name: scan_domain
title: Domain and frontend security scan
